bug_info.bug_desc: When performance counters are disabled (PerfCounterEn=0), reads of the MCOUNTINHIBIT CSR incorrectly raise a CSR read access exception. The inhibit CSR should remain accessible and expose the implemented hardwired inhibit state instead of causing an illegal-instruction/access exception.
bug_info.fix_hint: In the CSR read process, do not raise read_access_exception for CSR_MCOUNTINHIBIT solely because PerfCounterEn is disabled. Return the MCOUNTINHIBIT read value, with unavailable counter-inhibit bits remaining hardwired to zero.

bug_info.bug_desc: When performance counters are disabled (PerfCounterEn=0), writes to the MCOUNTINHIBIT CSR incorrectly raise a CSR update access exception. The write should not create or enable unavailable counters; instead, the inhibit state for unavailable performance counters should remain at its hardwired zero value.
bug_info.fix_hint: In the CSR write process, accept writes to CSR_MCOUNTINHIBIT without asserting update_access_exception when PerfCounterEn is disabled, and force the stored inhibit state to zero for the unavailable counters.
